create_DRRunner: create a DRRunner instance to orchestrate PPO rollouts across student agents with configurable learning rate and environment
run_DRRunner_run: run one PPO update step by calling DRRunner.run to perform rollouts and update student agent parameters
run_DRRunner_reset: reset the DRRunner state by calling DRRunner.reset with a JAX random key to initialize training
review_DRRunner_rollout_students: review the DRRunner._rollout_students method that scans rollout steps using JAX lax.scan for collecting transitions
review_DRRunner_compile_stats: review the DRRunner._compile_stats method that aggregates episode stats and environment metrics across students and devices
